policy: Evidence ranges are not automatic prescriptions. Safety, product composition, population and indication must be verified before activation.
supported_context: nutritional adequacy and pregnancy-related neural-tube-defect prevention

protocols.amount: RDA 400 mcg DFE/day adult, 600 pregnancy, 500 lactation; adult synthetic folate UL 1000 mcg/day
Specific folic-acid supplementation policy requires separate verified guideline and risk stratification

personalization: Do not conflate mcg DFE with mcg folic acid; distinguish preconception prevention from treating deficiency.
safety: high-risk pregnancy or previous neural tube defect -> clinician-led plan
next_review: Prioritize authoritative preconception supplementation guidance, timing and special risk groups.
